team.confirmReset: Reset 2FA for {email}? (their sessions are revoked too)
team.rules: · At least one Owner can't be demoted or removed. · Only Owners can assign or manage the Owner role. · Changing a role or removing a member revokes their sessions immediately.

invite.title: Add member
invite.note: Self-hosted: an admin sets the initial password (email invite links come later).

forced.title: Two-factor enrollment required

quiet.title: Quiet Hours

org.title: Organization security
org.require2faHint: When on, members without 2FA must enroll at their next sign-in before using the console.
org.graceHint: Recoverable within a 7-day grace period; permanently purged afterwards.
